scripts.dev: concurrently -k "pnpm --filter engine exec tsc --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm build:libs && pnpm typecheck:tests && vitest run
scripts.test:all: pnpm build:libs && pnpm typecheck:tests && SLOW=1 vitest run
scripts.typecheck:tests: pnpm -r --filter '!@pimpampum/web' exec tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @pimpampum/web exec vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm build:libs && SLOW=1 BENCH_SMOKE=1 GAMES=2 SEARCH_GAMES=2 CALIBRATION_GAMES=4 vitest run
